// Chokepoint fixture (config-toml, CONF-01): a second .paper/config.toml
// reader outside bin/lib/config.ts. It skips schema_version, migrations, the
// unknown-key warnings and the verify_quotes / endpoint refusals — the rule
// must flag it.
import { parse } from 'smol-toml';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

export function sneakyConfig(root: string): unknown {
  return parse(readFileSync(path.join(root, '.paper', 'config.toml'), 'utf8'));
}
